title: 渔家傲（天接云涛连晓雾）
author: 李清照
intro: In a dream, Li Qingzhao sails up the Milky Way to the palace of Heaven. The Lord of Heaven asks where she is going; she answers that her road is long and her talent wasted — and asks the great wind to blow her boat to the islands of the immortals.
analysis: 李清照的词大多细腻婉约，这首却气势雄伟，是她唯一一首“豪放”风格的作品。题目一作“记梦”，写一个梦境。上阕：天空连着翻滚的云海和晨雾，银河好像在转动，无数船帆在浪里起舞；她的魂魄好像回到了天帝住的地方，天帝很关心地问她要到哪里去。下阕是她的回答：路很长，天又快黑了；我学写诗，虽然有惊人的句子，却没有用处。接着笔锋一转：大鹏正乘着九万里长风高飞，风啊，不要停，把我的小船一直吹到海上的三座仙山去！“九万里风鹏正举”化用《庄子》里大鹏乘风而起的故事。这首词把她晚年漂泊无依的苦闷，变成了冲向远方的豪情，现实走投无路，梦里却要乘风远去。
analysisEn: Most of Li Qingzhao’s lyrics are delicate and intimate, but this one is vast and bold — the only one of her works in the “heroic” (豪放) style. Its subtitle in some editions is “Recording a Dream”. In the first half, the sky merges with rolling clouds and dawn mist; the Milky Way seems to turn, and a thousand sails dance on the waves. Her spirit seems to return to the dwelling of the Lord of Heaven, who kindly asks where she is going. The second half is her answer: the road is long, and she sighs that the day is almost done; she has written lines that astonish people, but to no purpose. Then the poem takes off. She borrows a famous image from the philosopher Zhuangzi: a giant bird, the péng, that rides a wind ninety thousand lǐ high. “Wind, don’t stop,” she says, “blow my little boat all the way to the Three Isles of the immortals!” In real life she was a widowed refugee with nowhere to go, and a woman whose talent the world had no use for. In the dream she refuses to stay small. That turn from frustration to soaring freedom is what readers remember.
background: Li Qingzhao (1084–c. 1155) is traditionally said to have written this around 1130, after following the fleeing Song court along the Zhejiang coast by sea. The sea voyage is often seen as the source of the poem’s images of clouds, waves and sails.
pronunciation: 仿佛 fǎng fú；殷勤 yīn qín；嗟 jiē；谩有 màn（徒然、空有）；鹏 péng；蓬舟 péng。“谩”机器朗读易读成 mán，已在朗读用字中换为同音字“慢”，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行教材文本，题一作《渔家傲·记梦》。异文：“仿佛”一作“彷佛”；“谩有”一作“漫有”。

lines.zh: 天接云涛连晓雾，星河欲转千帆舞。
lines.rhythm: 天接/云涛/连晓雾，星河/欲转/千帆舞
lines.py: tiān jiē yún tāo lián xiǎo wù, xīng hé yù zhuǎn qiān fān wǔ
lines.lit: The sky meets the waves of cloud and joins the dawn mist; the Star River is about to turn, a thousand sails dance.
lines.en: Sky runs into billowing cloud and the mist of dawn; the Milky Way begins to wheel, and a thousand sails are dancing.

lines.zh: 仿佛梦魂归帝所，闻天语，殷勤问我归何处。
lines.rhythm: 仿佛/梦魂/归帝所，闻/天语，殷勤/问我/归何处
lines.py: fǎng fú mèng hún guī dì suǒ, wén tiān yǔ, yīn qín wèn wǒ guī hé chù
lines.lit: It seems my dreaming soul returns to Heaven’s palace; I hear Heaven’s voice, kindly asking me where I am going.
lines.en: My dreaming soul seems to reach the Lord of Heaven’s hall. A voice from the sky asks me, gently, where I am bound.

lines.zh: 我报路长嗟日暮，学诗谩有惊人句。
lines.rhythm: 我报/路长/嗟日暮，学诗/谩有/惊人句
lines.py: wǒ bào lù cháng jiē rì mù, xué shī màn yǒu jīng rén jù
lines.lit: I reply: the road is long, I sigh that the day is late; I studied poetry, and in vain have startling lines.
lines.en: I answer: the road is long, and the day is nearly gone. I have written lines that startle people — and what good are they?
lines.tts: 我报路长嗟日暮，学诗慢有惊人句。

lines.py: jiǔ wàn lǐ fēng péng zhèng jǔ
lines.lit: On a ninety-thousand-li wind the roc is just rising.
lines.en: On a wind ninety thousand miles high, the great bird is soaring.

lines.zh: 风休住，蓬舟吹取三山去！
lines.rhythm: 风/休住，蓬舟/吹取/三山去
lines.py: fēng xiū zhù, péng zhōu chuī qǔ sān shān qù
lines.lit: Wind, do not stop! Blow my reed boat away to the Three Mountains!
lines.en: Wind, don’t drop! Blow my little boat all the way to the islands of the immortals!

words.en: the dwelling of the Lord of Heaven
words.note: 所：地方。现代汉语“场所”“住所”。
现代汉语仍用，如“献殷勤”。
古义“回答”；现代汉语“报告”“回报”。
也暗指人到晚年，如成语“日暮途穷”。
化用杜甫“语不惊人死不休”。现代汉语“惊人”仍常用。

words.en: the roc, a giant mythical bird
words.note: 出自《庄子·逍遥游》；成语“鹏程万里”祝人前程远大。
休：不要；住：停。现代汉语“停住”“站住”的“住”。

words.en: a small boat (light as a tumbleweed)
the three isles of the immortals in the eastern sea
words.note: 传说中的蓬莱、方丈、瀛洲三座仙山。

imagery.name: 银河
imagery.zh: “星河欲转”把天上的银河写成海上的大河，梦里人真的航行到了天上。
imagery.en: The turning Milky Way becomes a great river of the sky — in the dream she really sails up to Heaven.

imagery.name: 帆
imagery.zh: 千帆在云海里起舞，画面壮阔，也像她渡海时见过的景象。
imagery.en: A thousand sails dancing in a sea of clouds — a vast scene, perhaps remembered from her voyage by sea.

imagery.name: 鹏
imagery.zh: 乘风高飞的大鹏，是她想挣脱困境、远走高飞的理想。
imagery.en: The giant bird riding the wind is her own wish to break free and fly far away.

imagery.name: 风
imagery.zh: 九万里长风是推动一切的力量，她请求风不要停。
imagery.en: The ninety-thousand-li wind is the force that can carry her away — she begs it not to stop.

imagery.name: 船
imagery.zh: 小小的蓬舟要飞向仙山，弱小的人怀着远大的心。
imagery.en: A tiny boat bound for the isles of the immortals: a small person with a vast heart.
